answer: The identity is a decentralized identifier whose public document the owner updates with a signed transaction, rotating keys without changing the identifier itself. A Sybil attacker cannot update the document without the current key, so the identifier stays with its real owner, and every update is publicly verifiable. A lone pulse cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. A karst and a walnut may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
